'''Gusimin the Honest''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] [[permitor]] working in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]]. Unlike other permitors, Gusimin was not associated to any House, and as such was not biased to guide his customers to any specific business related to the House.

In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Gusimin approached a landing ship, hoping that the visitors would hire her as their permitor. Other prospectives included [[Furran]], [[Koyi Kobad]], [[Maltok]] and [[Sadana]]. All of them were disappointed to discover that they had already hired [[Fot Ducela]].
